# `.agents/templates/` — Design Artifacts

## Purpose

Templates for durable, reviewable planning artifacts. Templates are not always-on instructions and should be loaded only for the matching workflow.

This directory is **distributed** by `ainish-coder --rules` (it is contract surface, not repo
content): the shapes are useful in any repository. The *filled-in* artifacts they produce are
repo-local and live in `.agents/plans/`.

## Ownership

- `masters.md` — the nine dual-expertise advisory lenses an agent constitutes for a task.
- `egm-design.md` — the Elephant design artifact consumed by Goldfish review and implementation
  readiness checks. For interview-driven work, prefer `.agents/plans/{date}-{name}.plan.md` written by
  the `question-me` skill; this template remains for a written design handed to a reviewer.

## Verification

Validate a completed design with `bin/egm-check.sh --design <path>`.
